hypothesis: On the frozen admitted TRAIN positive token spans, explicitly competing with blank can recover tokens whose identity is already stronger than competing nonblank tokens but suppressed by blank. A shared B0 ordinary margin ceiling tests this recovery while retaining ordinary-speech suppression. This is a prospective mechanism test, not a causal explanation of a prior DEV failure.
feature_frontend: Unchanged 43876-parameter C11-compatible causal FSMN-CTC, original PCM16 log-mel, bit-equal B0/B9 mel/mean/scale, unchanged greedy ordered [1,2,3] event decoder.

pair.comparison: Identical B0 initialization, all source originals, repaired finite source/prefix draw, optimizer, frontend, CTC, gain consistency, ordinary B0 ceiling and positive teacher/source/spans. Only the positive margin competitor set changes between arms. No historical B17 parameter equality or B17 numerical replay is claimed.

shared_schedule_repair.historical_defect: B17 prefix index floor(step/35)+step%3 aliases with source group step%35: for step=g+35*epoch the prefix is g%3 forever. Saved COMMON_DRAW confirms every synthetic original saw only one prefix.
shared_schedule_repair.causal_scope: Coverage defect proven from code and original saved draw; contribution to any historical DEV outcome is unproven.
shared_schedule_repair.algorithm: Sort the same 35 paired synthetic group IDs lexicographically. Define group_width as the maximum ordinary/positive original count in that group (26 singleton and 9 two-original groups). First five complete 35-group passes, then 17 groups sorted by descending width and lexicographic group ID. At zero-based per-group visit v select each class original v modulo its group count; choose prefix index (lexical_group_index+floor(v/group_width)) modulo 3.
shared_schedule_repair.tail_prioritization: Structural original count then stable lexical identity only; no model score, loss, event or DEV metric is read.
shared_schedule_repair.natural_draw: Same existing 192 reviewed-natural original assignments as B17/B13; shared prefix schedule intentionally changes.
shared_schedule_repair.coverage_gate: All 79 synthetic and all nine natural originals must each receive all three prefixes before any optimization.

positive_retention.source: Exact original B9 positive TRAIN teacher arrays from completed run45111029245/artifact14790175198, already used by B14/B15/B17; original archive SHA0959221425bc38e8ca6501ace692c858741079f9223c4972d1cc318252d68ea8.
positive_retention.admission: All existing120 original/gain conditions for which B9 and historical B13 matched each complete [1,2,3]; admission not filtered by B21 or B0 misses.
positive_retention.alignment: Same first complete B9 word, same native nonblank frame runs, same source/gain and no prefix. No realignment, shifted frames or synthetic forced alignment.
positive_retention.challenger: ReLU((teacher[target]-max(teacher[all other three classes including blank]))-(student[target]-max(student[all other three classes including blank])))
positive_retention.aggregation: Mean frame loss within token, tokens within path, gains within original, originals within source group. Each step visits sorted eligible groups[step modulo34]. Both arms use all same120paths and identical source/gain features.
positive_retention.weight_rationale: Inherited auxiliary coefficient; no sweep, new margin threshold or DEV-based coefficient selection.

ordinary_ceiling.teacher: Frozen B0 on exact current ordinary TRAIN source/gain/prefix/full frame grid.
ordinary_ceiling.loss: Mean ReLU((student[k]-student[0])-(B0[k]-B0[0])) for k=1,2,3; tokens/frames, then gains, originals, source groups. Shared0.08 coefficient in both arms; lower nonblank-vs-blank margins unpenalized.
ordinary_ceiling.reuse: One shared fixed ordinary-teacher cache, no per-arm teacher forward duplication; reuse current student CTC logits.

saved_train_mechanism.population: Authenticate all528 B17 preoptimizer B0/B9 TRAIN arrays; diagnostic case population restricted to same120eligible positive original/gain combinations. No candidate or DEV arrays.
saved_train_mechanism.condition: B9 has a complete greedy event and B0 does not; within the B9 registered token runs, B0 target is strictly above both other nonblank logits but strictly below blank on at least one frame.
saved_train_mechanism.stop: If byte/source authentication or the registered mechanism fails, save the result and stop before model initialization/optimization. Do not resample, change the gate or use DEV to force a signal.

source_policy.allowed: Exactly prior79admitted synthetic TRAIN and nine owner-reviewed natural windows; frozen B0/B9 checkpoints and authenticated existing TRAIN teacher arrays.
forbidden: Any primary/replication/DEV waveform, logit or target in optimization
Threshold or coefficient selection on scored data

start_condition: Independent fresh B21 assessment frozen before optimizer; exact public first-attempt push from reviewed predecessor; source lineage, original bytes and finite-coverage gates pass. Source-only observations may precede training; model-dependent source screening must not select training data.
artifact_contract: Save each actual PT/NPZ/ONNX, all192step traces, shared source/prefix draw and coverage, original source manifests, zero-forward mechanism proof, file hashes, PT reload and NPZ tensor identity. ONNX structural validation is not C11/ARM parity. Candidate engineering validation stays closed until independent quality passes. B0 remains installed.
